title: Chapter 266 The Apprentice Of The Killing Master
content:
Chapter 266 The Apprentice Of The Killing Master

He beat the three peak powerhouses in the Immortal Emperor realm.

He had no choice but to run away.

The three powerful men of the Xiao clan did nothing, and just watched the long-haired man escape indifferently, indifferently.

Because they know how tenacious the vitality of a strong person in this state is.

Unless the strength difference is huge, no one can stop the other party if he wants to leave.

"Ancestor Xiao Meng, Ancestor Xiao Yong, you guys,"

Xiao Luo's eyes were moist and he was about to say something touching.

However, the three ancestors of the Xiao clan ignored Xiao Luo at all, but came straight to Lu Xue.

"Miss Lu, is it okay?"

The three of them looked at Lu Xue with concern in their eyes.

Xiao Luo, who was neglected on the side, looked at the scene in front of him and his mouth twitched slightly.

Becoming an outsider with me, right?

My surname is Xiao!

But at this moment, the three ancestors of the Xiao clan only had Lu Xue in their eyes, and Xiao Luo was directly ignored by them.

When Lu Xue heard the worried words of the three of them, she felt a little embarrassed.

"Thank you, three seniors, Lu Xue is fine."

Hearing this, the three of them slowly breathed a sigh of relief.

"It's fine, it's fine."

Not only the three of them, but the entire Xiao clan is grateful for Lu Xue.

If it weren't for Lu Xue and Lu Daosheng, I'm afraid that now there would be only these old guys left in the entire Xiao clan.

Where is the powerful Xiao clan now?

Xiao Luo, who was standing by, also understood this truth very well, so he had no complaints about it.

"Three seniors, that guy just now,"

At this time, Lu Xue hesitated.

Hearing this, Xiao Meng, the leader, snorted coldly and said, "It was just a garbage that was used to escape reality back then. There were not a few of them. They were sleeping in the darkness of the fairy world, just to wait until the golden world came to capture the world. Good fortune, ascend to the Immortal Emperor."

"The most important thing is to massacre geniuses like you who have not yet grown up but have great opportunities."

"They got your chance to grow stronger."

Xiao Meng's long-haired man slowly told the story of people like Xiao Meng, with disgust in his eyes.

The same is true for the other two powerful Xiao clans on the side.

"Miss Lu, and Xiao Luo, you must be more careful. If you don't have enough strength, try not to hang out."

Xiao Yong also reminded him.

Hearing this, Lu Xue and others nodded seriously.

"Thank you for telling me, I'll write it down."

Since Lu Xue’s parents, including the entire wasteland city, Lu Xue has become much more sensible with her naked eyes.

At this moment, there was movement in the distance again in the void.

"Which Tiansha dares to touch my disciples, and make lanterns in the pit, can you find shit?!"

An angry roar came.

Before the person arrives, the sound arrives first.

I have to say that cultural people speak differently.

Hearing this familiar voice, Qin Feng looked overjoyed.

"Master, it's Master, hahaha!"

Sure enough, everyone looked at it.

A dazzling sword light flashed by, and an old man in a long robe and holding a long sword showed his true appearance.

It is the instructor of the inner courtyard of Tiandi Academy, the master of Tianjian Peak, and Wang Hao!

"Master, you are finally here. Your disciple is almost beaten to death!"

Qin Feng ignored his face and rushed towards Wang Hao, tears streaming down his face.

It can be said that he is extremely aggrieved.

Seeing this, Lu Xue and the other two looked contemptuous, and suddenly looked like they didn't know Qin Feng, and turned their heads to look at the sky.

Wang Hao quickly looked around.

After seeing Lu Xue and others and the three powerful people of the Xiao clan, Wang Hao also understood immediately.

The crisis has been resolved.

"Get up, don't show me your eyes outside."

Wang Hao kicked Qin Feng in front of him, and then Qin Feng immediately stood up with a smile.

"You are the tutor Wang Hao of Tiandi Academy, right?"

At this time, Xiao Meng looked at Wang Hao and spoke.

Upon hearing this, Wang Hao nodded and said, "No, it's me."

"I admire my name for a long time."

"Hahaha, it's all just false names."

Wang Hao waved his hand, but the smile on his face became deeper and deeper.

After a moment, Wang Hao learned about what had just happened, and his face went from angry to solemn.

"It seems that the fairyland is going to be uneasy recently."

The relationship between the Xiao clan and Tiandi Academy has always been good, and now, Xiao Yin has become the instructor of the Academy's inner courtyard, and the relationship between the two forces has also reached a higher level.

Wang Hao chatted with the three powerful men of the Xiao clan, and then rushed back to Tiandi Academy with Lu Xue and others.

"Master, nothing happened in the academy recently, right?"

On the way, Qin Feng asked hesitantly.

Wang Hao snorted lightly and said, "What can happen in the academy? But you kid, without saying a word, actually went to the Wood Fairy World to watch the alchemy competition. Why, have you seen something?"

Hearing this, Qin Feng smiled.

"Master, I haven't gone in vain this time."

As soon as he finished speaking, a faint breath of sword art came from Qin Feng's body.

And this aura immediately changed Wang Hao's face.

"Boy, you!"

Qin Feng smiled and said, "Master, this time, the disciples must show their skills."

Looking at Qin Feng's confident face, Wang Hao was slightly stunned, and then burst into laughter.

"Not bad, not bad."

"By the way, Master, I have one more thing to say."

"explain."

Qin Feng Shenxixi said, "Master, do you know who competed with Teacher Qiao this time in the Wood Immortal Realm's alchemy competition?"

Regarding the competition between Shi Liantian and Jordanyang in the Wood Fairy Realm, this important news has not spread throughout the entire fairyland.

But what is unknown is that this news will inevitably shock the entire fairyland.

Kill the Refining Heaven!

This legendary peerless alchemy monster.

He is still alive as a legend in the history of alchemy.

Bang!

Wang Hao slapped Qin Feng in the head with a slap, "Stop keeping it a secret, say it quickly!"

Seeing this, Qin Feng took a deep breath, but he didn't dare to say much.

"Shi Liantian, the one who competes with Teacher Qiao to try the pill is Master Shi Liantian."

As soon as these words came out, Wang Hao looked slightly stunned, and the next moment he shouted: "Impossible!"

Kill the Refining Heaven? !

What kind of fucking age are these people?

I am probably just a child in front of the other side.

And now, I am old, tell me that the old monster is still alive.

"Master, it's true. If you don't believe me, ask Sister Xue and the others."

Upon hearing this, Xiao Luo also said, "Master Wang, Brother Qin is right. The one who competes with Master Qiao to practice the alchemy is indeed Master Shi Liantian."

"and,,,"

"And what?"

"cough."

Xiao Luo coughed lightly, looked at Yuanyuan who had been silent on the side, and said, "This is Master Shi's apprentice."

"What?!"

Wang Hao looked at the girl in shock who had a low presence and was not very talkative.

This girl is actually the apprentice of Master Shi Liantian!
